newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Taiwan stock index futures end weak.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Taiwan stock index futures end weak.

text.p: SIMEX Taiwan stock index futures ended lower in relatively light trade on Monday following losses in Taipei stocks as investors fell prey to fears of declining law and order and political uncertainty.
The May MSCI Taiwan index contract ended at 338.5 against its opening 340.0 on volume of 925 lots.
Dealers said the market got off to a slow but reasonably firm start on the back of Wall Street's strong gains on Friday.

But it was then sold down as Taipei stocks fell after a student protest to demand the resignation of Prime Minister Lien Chan, following a mass demonstration on Sunday over the government's failure to check a spate of violent crimes.
Taiwan's weighted share index ended 45.24 points down at 8,269.43 after falling as low as 8,213.12 in intra-day trade.

"Many technical analysts believe the 8,000 level is still to be tested in the current downward move as sentiment remains nervous at the current cash index level," Refco Singapore Pte Ltd said in a daily commentary.
